reason: Unknown control sequence: MathJax reports `Undefined control sequence \thisIsNotAMacro`.
Bare unknown control sequence must be reported as math-unknown-macro, not silently dropped.
`\frac` needs two arguments; only one was supplied.
`\frac` with no arguments is an error.
`\sqrt` bracket and brace do not pair: the optional argument is unterminated.
Unclosed `{` after the second argument — math-unbalanced-braces.
Unclosed group `{` must be reported as math-unbalanced-braces.
Unmatched closing brace must be reported as math-unbalanced-braces.
A bare `matrix` environment outside a math delimiter: the matrix environment is only valid inside math mode, so this must be reported rather than rendered as a paragraph.
`\left(` has no matching `\right)`: MathJax reports a missing `\right`.
Alignment tab `&` outside an alignment environment inside inline math.
Reaction arrow with no right-hand side.
`\pu` with a value but no unit.
`\textcolor` needs a colour and a body.
`\begin{cases}` closed by `\end{cases*}` — environment name mismatch, must be reported as math-unbalanced-environment.
